subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A smart reader does not only count stars.”?
options: It asks whether every student can actually use it.
A smart reader asks who wrote them, when, and why.
Second, never leave cake where a smart dog can reach it.
A smart worker learns from both the screen and the street.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It asks whether every student can actually use it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A smart reader does not only count stars. A smart reader asks who wrote them, when, and why.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Second, never leave cake where a smart dog can reach it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A smart worker learns from both the screen and the street.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A smart reader does not only count stars. A smart reader asks who wrote them, when, and why.」，答案為「A smart reader asks who wrote them, when, and why.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A smart reader asks who wrote them, when, and why.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
